name: SKY Blocks
author: sky-color studio

sections.description:
This plugin adds blocks for creators to build their websites. It includes various blocks such as a gallery block and a balloon block.

Key Features

  • Accordion
  • Extra gallery
  • Balloon
  • Banner list
  • Counter
  • Definition list
  • Hand clap
  • Lastpostdate
  • Message
  • One cushion
  • Share button
  • Simple columns
  • Simple image
  • Spoiler
  • Text changer
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate SKY Blocks through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the Setting page from the admin menu.
